events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) firms up over his right foot when marginal contact occurs as Coulibaly (WAS) goes over the pick.
Coulibaly (WAS) trails Ingles's (MIN) path with a resting hand, which he does not extend or apply force with during Ingles's driving shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) rests his left hand on Valančiūnas (WAS) as his right hand cleanly deflects the ball during the rebound.
Valančiūnas (WAS) drifts toward Gobert (MIN) when marginal body contact occurs after he releases his layup attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Gobert (MIN) jumps to contest the shot attempt when his left forearm comes out slightly, causing marginal body contact to occur during Kuzma's (WAS) shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) grasps and releases Valančiūnas's (WAS) jersey off-ball without affecting his FOM.
Valančiūnas (WAS) reaches for the ball and avoids contact with Gobert's (MIN) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Ingles (MIN) firms up in Valanciunas's (WAS) path and marginal contact occurs as both players come together during the off-ball screen.
Gobert (MIN) firms up in Coulibaly's (WAS) path and marignal contact occurs during the pick. This contact does not rise to the level of a foul.
Kuzma (WAS) legally contests McDaniels's (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Ingles (MIN) wraps his arms around Brogdon's (WAS) shoulders and pulls him to the ground. This contact dislodges him from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Marginal body contact occurs under the basket as Valančiūnas (WAS) and Gobert (MIN) engage before Valančiūnas releases toward the rebound.
Poole (WAS) brings his hand forward and marginal contact occurs with Alexander-Walker's (MIN) back as he moves around the screen.
Poole (WAS) attempts to go for the steal and initiates contact with Alexander-Walker's (MIN) arm, affecting Alexander-Walker's SQBR.
Coulibaly (WAS) applies both hands to Conley's (MIN) body and initiates illegal contact after Conley has begun his upward shooting motion, which affects Conley's jump shot attempt.
Poole (WAS) and Alexander-Walker's (MIN) feet become entangled as the two come together off-ball and the incidental contact causes Alexander-Walker to lose his footing.
Alexander-Walker (WAS) deflects the pass out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with WAS.
McDaniels (MIN) and Poole (WAS) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Valančiūnas (WAS) engages with Alexander-Walker (MIN) off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Valančiūnas releases away to retrieve the pass.
Conley's (MIN) foot comes down out of bounds prior to him releasing the ball on his pass. Possession should have remained with WAS.
Kuzma (WAS) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (MIN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
